reviews.text: This cleanser has a rich, creamy texture that creates a nice lather and leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I love the luxurious feel, but it can leave my skin a little dry after washing, so I prefer using it when my skin needs a thorough cleanse. The packaging also feels elegant and premium.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品質地濃郁、綿密，起泡效果好好，洗完令皮膚感覺清潔、清爽。我好鍾意佢嘅奢華感，但洗完之後可能會令皮膚有少少乾燥，所以我通常喺皮膚需要徹底清潔嗰陣先用。包裝都感覺優雅、高級。

reviews.text: This cleansing foam from Sulwhasoo is one of my HG and I have repurchased it many times. I absolutely love how easily it foams up, and the natural herbal scent is really refreshing and invigorating with an aromatherapy feel. It cleanses my skin well but doesn't leave it stripped. I would recommend this to anyone.
reviews.zh: 呢款係 Sulwhasoo 嘅潔面泡沫，係我嘅心頭好（HG），我已經回購咗好多次。我好鍾意佢幾容易起泡，天然草本香味令人精神一振，有啲芳香療法嘅感覺。潔面效果好好，而且唔會令皮膚被洗到好乾。我會推薦畀任何人。

reviews.text:
although I usually prefer a cream cleanser, this one is just that good
I love the herbal ginseng scent and the soft texture 
One of the best cleansing foams I’ve tried. 
You only need a tiny amount with a little water to get a rich, creamy lather.

It cleanses really well while leaving my skin feeling clean, soft and hydrated.
reviews.zh:
雖然我通常都鍾意乳霜式潔面產品，但呢款真係咁好。
我好鍾意佢嘅草本人參香味同柔軟質地。
係我試過最好嘅潔面泡沫之一。
只需要少少分量，加少少水就可以起濃郁綿密嘅泡沫。

潔面效果好好，洗完令皮膚感覺清潔、柔軟同水潤。

reviews.text: This cleansing foam is gentle, comfortable, and cleanses my skin very well without leaving it feeling tight or dry. It creates a soft lather and removes impurities easily, while keeping my skin feeling clean and smooth. I love how fresh and balanced my face feels after using it.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面泡沫好溫和、舒服，潔面效果好好，而且唔會令皮膚繃緊或者乾燥。佢起嘅泡好軟，容易去除污垢，同時令皮膚感覺清潔、順滑。我好鍾意用完之後，面感覺好清新、平衡。

reviews.text: This ismy royal cleanser.I use it for special occasions.Has e very special perfume,light and refreshing citrus like.Oily texture that becomes foamy too.But the oil is enough as I like it.Perfect for mature or dry skin.Mine is super oily but I like this texture a lot!!!!!!
reviews.zh: 呢款係我嘅皇家潔面產品，我係特別嘅日子先用。有一種好特別嘅香味，清淡、清爽，帶柑橘味。質地係油狀，遇水會起泡。但油量剛好，我好鍾意。好啱成熟或者乾性皮膚。我嘅皮膚超級油，但我好鍾意呢款質地！！！！！！

reviews.text: I received a mini of this in one of my kits and loved it, so I decided to purchase the larger size. It works great for creating that really clean feeling on your skin without stripping away the nutrients. It's ok on eye makeup, but I have always found a cream cleanser or oil cleanser to be better for that. My search continues for the best one of those, but this cleanser is a winner. And it smells great too!
reviews.zh: 我喺一個套裝入面收到咗呢款嘅迷你裝，好鍾意，所以決定買大樽。佢好有效，可以令皮膚感覺非常清潔，又唔會洗走養分。用嚟卸眼妝都仲可以，不過我一直覺得乳霜式或者油性潔面產品會更適合卸眼妝。我仍然喺搵嗰類產品入面最好嘅一款，但呢款都係一款好產品。而且香味都好好聞！

reviews.text: Love it. It’s a repurchase for me. I have been using this for months now. Definitely on my favorite list. I highly recommend this. Only thing is if you have super oily skin you might not enjoy this as much. I have combo skin and usually save it for the dried area of my face.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！我係回購嘅。我用咗幾個月，絕對係我嘅最愛之一。我非常推薦。唯一要講嘅係，如果你嘅皮膚好油，你可能冇咁鍾意。我係混合性皮膚，通常只係用喺面上比較乾嘅位置。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
